articles.title: NPR’s Mid-Year Music Picks: From Dream Labs to Country Comebacks
articles.summary: What if an album could transport you to a lab where scientists record dreams? NPR’s critics just dropped their top 24 albums and songs of 2026 so far, spanning Kacey Musgraves’ country revival, a Korean collective’s surreal concept, and a mysterious R&B newcomer. There’s a sound for every curious ear.

articles.title: Bone Conduction Headphones in 2026: The Best Picks for Runners, Swimmers, and Everyday Adventures
articles.summary: What if you could listen to music without blocking your ears? Bone conduction headphones vibrate sound through your cheekbones, and WIRED’s latest guide reveals the top models for 2026. From Shokz’s swim-ready OpenSwim Pro with 32 GB of storage to Suunto’s wind-fighting Sonic, there’s a pair for every activity.

articles.title: Kate Douglass vs. Summer McIntosh: Who’s the Most Versatile Female Swimmer?
articles.summary: When Kate Douglass shattered the 50-meter freestyle world record, it reignited a debate: can anyone match her range? She’s also the Olympic champ in the 200 breaststroke—a combo so rare it’s almost absurd. A SwimSwam poll pitted her against Summer McIntosh, whose world records span 400 free to 400 IM. Who won?
